decisions.stateRoot: platform-specific versioned per-repository root; no repository, .git, shared cache or undeclared temporary fallback
decisions.ownership: owner nonce plus PID, process-start token and privacy-safe boot digest
decisions.durability: lock/CAS/prepared journal/atomic rename/readback; weaker directory durability is process-crash-only
decisions.cleanup: exact manifest/lease/process identity only; no broad process or path cleanup
decisions.secrets: external broker with ephemeral delivery only; secret bytes never durable

onboardingAndStart.requirement: onboarding and pipeline-start must expose typed, idempotent repair plans and retry without recursive repair/deadlock
